probe.name: full-precision-e-notation
probe.rationale: Rewrites all five files using full-precision 17-significant-digit %.17e scientific notation for every data cell and integer spellings for the Frame column (0 instead of 0.0). This is a valid representation alternative, not a scientific difference: the contract requires at least 12 significant digits and explicitly compares decoded numeric values rather than text formatting or float width, and %e-style full precision is called out as acceptable. Verified locally on a fresh copy of the reference outputs: every cell parses to a value exactly equal to the reference cell (parsed-value equality asserted for all five files against the reference copies), headers, row counts and Frame identities are preserved, and each file is textually changed so the mutation is real. This ensures the grader accepts legitimate format/width variations instead of over-rejecting on text spelling.
probe.script:
import csv,os,tempfile,io
for P in ['open_closed_backbone_rmsd.csv','backbone_rmsd.csv','core_ca_rmsd.csv','mass_weighted_rmsd.csv','resid_weighted_rmsd.csv']:
    with open(P,newline='') as f: rows=list(csv.reader(f))
    assert len(rows)>=2
    has_frame=len(rows[0])>1
    buf=io.StringIO(); w=csv.writer(buf,lineterminator='\n')
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        if i==0:
            out=r
        else:
            out=[]
            for j,x in enumerate(r):
                v=float(x)
                if j==0 and has_frame:
                    out.append(str(int(v)))
                else:
                    out.append('%.17e'%v)
        w.writerow(out)
    text=buf.getvalue()
    orig=open(P,'rb').read().decode()
    assert text!=orig, 'expected textual change in '+P
    fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(dir='.',suffix='.tmp')
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w',newline='') as f: f.write(text)
    os.replace(tmp,P)
